UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user in the ALCHE academy, tracking their progress and XP.

uid.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the user.

photoURL.description: URL to the user's profile photo.

completedPages.description: Array of page IDs the user has completed.

completedModules.description: Array of module IDs the user has completed.

quizStates.description: JSON stringified object storing the user's progress in various quizzes.

role.description: The user's role in the platform.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was created.

country.description: The user's selected country for the leaderboard.

welcomeWatched.description: Whether the user has watched the welcome video.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user profiles, progress, and XP.
